donor_eligible: remove-one full-window delta_loss non-positive and both half deltas non-positive; conservative operationalization of low cost/no positive half penalty
receiver_eligible: add-one full-window delta_loss negative and both half deltas negative
pair_eligible: full and each split predicted gain positive; distinct path units; exclude same-layer pairs
exchange_acceptance: accept only if joint full-window tuning NLL decreases and both split deltas are non-positive; otherwise stop
